text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean by that?! 
How could you possibly close such a 
wonderful shop?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What's going on?! 
What happened?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-That yelling just now— 
Is it true that... you're closin' down the 
shop?!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Well, yes. 
Oh dear, I'm sorry to have gathered a 
crowd around me like this.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
This shop used to be quite bustling in the 
old days. We employed several workers, 
wholesale-supplied our traditional sweets 
to corporate clients, and so forth—

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
However, times have changed. Western 
confectionery is the star of the show 
these days. Our staff dwindled—and the son 
I had hoped would take over went into 
another line of work.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
There's no longer any reason to force 
ourselves to keep going... 
I figured it was about time to call it a 
day.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Well, there's no point in continuing to 
make things nobody wants anymore, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That ain't true at all!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yukino-san...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry about that. Raising my voice 
like that all of a sudden... 
B-But still...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sayin' nobody wants 'em just ain't true! 
Not when this shop makes such wonderful 
sweets...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If more folks just knew about it... this 
place could be just as lively and bustling 
as any other shop!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, dear. 
But you really don't need to trouble 
yourself for my sake, Yukino-chan.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
These days, Western sweets are what people 
think of for special occasions, and the 
whole town is painted in Valentine's 
colors right now. There's just no place 
for an old shop like ours—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then... let's make new Japanese sweets 
for this shop! 
Sweets perfect for Valentine's that'll 
bring in customers!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know it won't be easy... But still! 
I can't bear the thought of this shop 
disappearing with you feeling so lonely, 
thinkin' nobody wants what you make!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm just an amateur, a girl who doesn't 
know the first thing about any of this... 
but if it's to help liven up this shop, 
I'll do whatever it takes!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I totallyyyy get ittt! You wanna help out, 
right, Yuki-chan?! 
For the sake of this sweet granny who's 
worked so hard for so long!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna help toooooo!! 
Let's do our best together!! We're gonna 
bring this shop back to liiiiifeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on now, girls... please stop. 
Why should young folks like you go through 
all this trouble for a rundown old shop 
like mine...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—No. There is nothing 'rundown' about this 
place. 
This shop is overflowing with tradition 
and the warmth of those who cherish it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
While we were talking, I had a look around 
the store... 
Every corner has been swept spotlessly 
clean. Every item is arranged in neat, 
orderly rows—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And above all, these brightly colored 
Japanese sweets evoke the feeling of early 
spring in February... 
This is undeniably the heartfelt work of a 
true master craftsman!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
To let such 'brilliance' fade away in 
silence, unknown to anyone— 
I cannot simply stand by and accept that. 
Please allow me to lend my aid as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! We must dash forward with a 
Bakushin spirit rather than give up! 
As class president, I shall also assist 
and ensure this shop makes a glorious 
comeback!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And—so that we may enjoy delicious sakura 
mochi for years to come!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What do you say?! If we all combine our 
strength, won't you give it one more 
try... 
and let us help rebuild the shop?

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
If you all believe in me that much, let's 
give it a shot. 
...I'll be counting on you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—I-I'm really sorry about all that, 
Cafe-san. 
I kinda dragged you into everything in the 
heat of the moment.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right. Though... it was 
rare, to see that from you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've... hardly ever seen you raise your 
voice like that, Yukino-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahaha... y-yeah... Gosh, that was so 
embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Living out in the countryside, our 
relatives were real close. 
Folks were droppin' by our house all the 
time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And whenever they did, they'd always bring 
traditional Japanese sweets with 'em.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Clear and cool-lookin' in the summer, 
wrapped in maple leaves in the autumn... 
They were like little treasures that 
changed with each season.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We'd sip tea and savor 'em together... 
Not talkin' about anything fancy... just 
relaxin' and enjoyin' the taste.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...They are very precious memories to you, 
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! N-No, that's really the only 
reason, so... 
you don't have to force yourself to go 
along with me, Cafe-san—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No. I... would be glad to help.
